title: [v3] Blank window on Linux X11 with Nvidia (including workarounds)
body:
There is a known, recurring issue with nvidia hardware and proprietary drivers with webkit2gtk where a blank or fully white screen will be drawn. This issue pops up in Wails v3 both with `-tags gtk4` and without.

The symptom is very simple: On linux, the app is blank and we cannot interact with it. Passing `GTK_DEBUG=interactive` as an environment variable shows us there is actual content in the window, even if we can't do anything with it.

Disabling hardware acceleration is a known workaround:
> $ cd v3/examples/
>
> $ ## This works:
> $ WEBKIT_DISABLE_COMPOSITING_MODE=1 go run ./window
> $ ## Works, but may have big performance implications.
> 
> $ ## This should also work:
> $ WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 go run ./window
> $ ## It's unclear if disabling dmabuf has performance penalty.
> 
> $ ## Disabling egl and glx together fixes it, but only on gtk4 and not if only one is disabled. It's just disabling all hw accel.
> $ GDK_DEBUG=dmabuf:misc GDK_DISABLE=egl:glx go run -tags gtk4 ./window

Having to disable egl and glx together implies the issue lies outside this domain.

This issue does **not** crop up when using Wails v2 with `wails dev -tags webkit2_41` for reasons I'm unsure of; I have not had issues with blank screen on Wails v2.

Notable themes:
* Webkit-gtk issue
* Reported graphics stack is always nvidia proprietary drivers, reported 377.* up to 580.* with affected graphics cards being nvidia 10 series (and a single GT 710 report)
* Reports similar scenarios on Wayland and X11 but many Wayland issues get resolved so this is a much harder to troubleshoot issue on X11
* Nothing interesting reported on the command line
* Not related to gtk4
* Affects multiple webkit apps
* Affects 2017 to present

Related discussion:
[Wails user reports blank screen both with and without -tags gtk4](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/issues/4957#issuecomment-3850267228)
[jsaddle-webkit2gtk user has this issue and solves it with env variable](https://github.com/reflex-frp/reflex-platform/issues/735#issuecomment-1120306018)
[Webkit bugzilla report for this issue with reports from 2017 up to 2022](https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=180739)
[A thread with a TON of discussion on blank views in webkit-gtk apps; bookmarked at the solution to a handful](https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=261874#c32)
[This issue is a mess and seems related but is actually only tangentially so](https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=238244)
[Discussion mentioning EGL-X11 used by GTK4](https://discourse.gnome.org/t/gtk4-and-legacy-opengl/25980)
[Discussing webkitgtk hardware acceleration](https://blogs.igalia.com/carlosgc/2023/04/03/webkitgtk-accelerated-compositing-rendering/)

There is one interesting note in the bookmarked link:
```
In this case [X11] I think we are failing to map the imported DMA-BUF, gbm_bo_map() fails, but I still don't know why. A possible workaround if you are using GTK4 if to use GDK_DEBUG=gl-egl to force GTK to use EGL, so that we don't need to map the imported buffer. There's no workaround for GTK3, we need to figure out why gbm_bo_map is failing and fix it.
```

Unfortunately, gl-egl is no longer a valid GDK_DEBUG option. However, the discussion on the gnome forums prompted me to install the gentoo package for `gui-libs/egl-x11` which is not installed by default with `nvidia-drivers` and installs `gui-libs/eglexternalplatform`.

This accomplishing nothing.

But there's also `gui-libs/egl-gbm` which, after installing and restarting, results in a new error:
> $ go run ./window
> Failed to create GBM buffer of size 800x562: Invalid argument
> $ go run -tags gtk4 ./window
> Could not create GBM EGL display: EGL_SUCCESS. Aborting...
>
> $ ## This is what we tried before, interesting it does not work now:
> $ GDK_DEBUG=dmabuf:misc GDK_DISABLE=egl:glx go run -tags gtk4 ./window
> Could not create GBM EGL display: EGL_SUCCESS. Aborting...

With these errors we find:
[Tauri with webkit has the same issue and similar issue under Wayland.](https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/issues/11988https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/issues/11988)
[Similar issues solved in better-iptv app by setting W_D_D_R=1](https://github.com/mewset/better-iptv/commit/da229ed42017c9e2211352a2b14245c369d2acb9)

### TL;DR
From what I've found, using `WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1` is what works and it doesn't report that hardware-acceleration has been disabled.

**Things I'd like to see:**
* A Qt webview version ;)
* Some documentation on this issue added to the "known issues" page for future searchers
* An example app for wails v3 that's graphically stressful and reports GPU related performance. This way, I can try all the various environments and toggles and see if there's a best performer.

If there's no performance hit, then I'd recommend always setting W_D_D_R=1 on linux+nvidia proprietary+X11 environment, possibly others as more issues are filed. I'm not sure how Wails can handle this by default, but it may be a huge PITA for downstream developers if you simply expect them to know about this and deal with it on their own.
